name: autocomplete-with-http
description: Debounces user input through a MatAutocomplete-backed input, calling an HTTP endpoint per query with switchMap so stale responses can't overwrite newer ones.
templateCode:
<mat-form-field appearance="outline">
  <mat-label>Search users</mat-label>
  <input matInput [formControl]="searchControl" [matAutocomplete]="auto" />
  <mat-autocomplete #auto="matAutocomplete" [displayWith]="displayUser">
    <mat-option *ngFor="let user of users$ | async" [value]="user">
      {{ user.name }}
    </mat-option>
  </mat-autocomplete>
</mat-form-field>
notes: debounceTime + distinctUntilChanged + switchMap is the standard combination for autocomplete-over-HTTP: switchMap cancels the previous in-flight request automatically when a new keystroke arrives, so stale responses can't overwrite a newer, correct result.
displayWith must handle the value being either a User object (after selection) or the raw typed string (before selection) — MatAutocomplete calls it for both states.

catchError belongs inside the inner HTTP pipe, not around the whole valueChanges$ chain — an uncaught error from one request would otherwise terminate the Observable and silently stop all future searches.
